Name: Build On Any Tile
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b]Build On Any Tile[/b] allows farm buildings to be placed on otherwise nonvalid tiles, such as water and other obstructions.
[line]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. [b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b]
2. [b]Download Build On Any Tile[/b] from the Files tab, [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/releases]the Releases page on GitHub[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/827525-build-on-any-tile]ModDrop[/url].
3. [b]Unzip Build On Any Tile[/b] into the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.

[b]Multiplayer note:[/b]
[list]
[*]Each player who wants to place buildings on nonvalid tiles will need to install this mod, but it is not required otherwise.
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Options[/size][/b]

Build On Any Tile includes options to enable or disable building placement on certain terrain types and obstructions.

To edit these options:

1. [b]Run the game[/b] using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file in the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\BuildOnAnyTile[/i] folder.
2. [b]Exit the game[/b] and open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editing program.

See the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile]GitHub readme[/url] for more information about each option.

This mod also supports spacechase0's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. Players with that mod will be able to change config.json settings from Stardew's main menu.
[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

Build On Any Tile supports translation of its GMCM setting names and descriptions.

When Stardew is launched, a file with the appropriate language code is loaded from the [i]BuildOnAnyTile/i18n[/i] folder, or [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/blob/master/BuildOnAnyTile/i18n/default.json]default.json[/url] if no specific translation exists. [b]Note that Stardew must be restarted to update GMCM's displayed language.[/b]

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files by linking them in a comment, submitting a GitHub pull request, or any other method.

The mod currently includes these translations:

[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/blob/master/BuildOnAnyTile/i18n/default.json]English[/url]
[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/blob/master/BuildOnAnyTile/i18n/pt.json]Brazilian Portuguese[/url] (by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/73534233-roxasalt/]RoxasAlt[/url])
[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/blob/master/BuildOnAnyTile/i18n/ko.json﻿]Korean[/url] (by [url=https://github.com/wally232]wally232[/url])
[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/BuildOnAnyTile/blob/master/BuildOnAnyTile/i18n/zh.json]Simplified Chinese[/url] (by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/72860268-chasqiu/]chasqiu[/url])
